spans.s:
प्रो(प्रौ)ष्ठः
1 A bull, an ox.
--2
A bench, stool.
--3 A kind of flish
(ष्ठी also).
--Comp.
--पदः the
month भाद्रपद.
--(दा) the 25th and
26th lunar mansions; पूर्वाभाद्रपदा
and उत्तराभाद्रपदा.
--पाद a. born
under the above Nakṣatra.

प्रो(प्रौ)ह a.
1 A reasoner,
disputant.
--2 Skilful, clever.
--हः
1 Reasoning, logic.
--2 An elephant's
foot or ankle.
--3 A knot, joint.

प्रो(प्रौ)ढ a. [प्र + वह् --क्त वा
वृद्धिः]
1 Full-grown, fully
developed, matured, ripened, perfected,
full, (as moon &c.); प्रौढपुष्पैः कदंबैः

.
--3 Thick, dense, pitchy; प्रौढं तमः
कुरु कृतज्ञतयैव भद्रं

.
--7 Luxuriant.
--8
Married.
--9 Full of, filled with (at the
end of comp.)
--10 Raised or lifted
up.
--11 Controverted, discussed.
--ढा A bold and grown-up woman,
no longer bashful or timid in
the presence of her lord, one of the
four principal female characters
in poetic compositions;
आषोडशाद्भवेद्बाला त्रिंशता तरुणी मता । पंचपंचशता प्रौढा
भवेद्वृद्धा ततः परम् ॥.
--Comp.
--अंगना a bold woman; see above.
--उक्तिः f. a bold or pompous
assertion.
--पाद a. one whose feet are
raised on a bench.
--पुष्प a.
having full-grown blossoms;

.
--प्रताप a. of great or mighty
valour.
--योवन a. advanced in
youth.
--वादः an arrogant or bold
assertion, defiant speech.

प्रौ(प्रो)ढिः f.
1 Full growth or
development, maturity, perfection.
--2 Growth, increase.
--3 Greatness,
grandeur, elevation, dignity;

.
--4 Boldness, audacity.
--5
Pride, arrogance, self-confidence.
--6 Controversy, discussion.
--7 Zeal,
exertion, enterprize.
--Comp.
--वादः
{1} a grandiloquent or pompous
speech. {2} a bold assertion.

To become matured,
ripen, be developed, grow up.
--2
To increase.

प्रौष्ठपदः N. of the month
Bhādrapada.
--दी The full moon in the
month of Bhādrapada.
